# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary analysis documents generated as part of the ZavaLoanOriginationAPI cloud-readiness assessment. Each document provides a different lens on the application to support migration planning.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [Architecture Diagram](architecture-diagram.md) | High-level application architecture (technology stack, data storage, external services) and component relationship diagram (Servlet interactions and data flow) |
| [Dependency Map](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all declared external dependencies grouped by functional category, with version and compatibility risk analysis |
| [API & Service Communication Contracts](api-service-contracts.md) | Inventory of all HTTP endpoints, downstream service calls, communication patterns, resilience policies, and security posture |
| [Data Architecture & Persistence Layer](data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, entity model (ER diagram), data ownership boundaries, and data classification/sensitivity analysis |
| [Configuration & Externalized Settings Inventory](configuration-inventory.md) | All configuration sources, properties, environment variables, secrets handling, and framework/runtime versions |
| [Core Business Workflows](business-workflows.md) | Domain entities, primary business workflows (loan origination pipeline), decision logic, state transitions, and business rules |
